identityReview: Moussa Faki Mahamat, Chadian, born June 21, 1960 Biltine. Former prime minister 2003–2005, foreign minister 2008–2017, AU Commission Chairperson from March 14, 2017 to March 13, 2025; current 4P Special Envoy appointed June 2025. Commission chair differs from rotating AU chair; 4P envoy differs from UN envoy/OECD secretary-general. Historical doctoral thesis registration does not establish doctorate completion. Historical CV end-date “present” must not override actual service end.
lifeStatusEvidence: VNA French report on October 11, 2026 describes actual Faki remarks during October 10–11 Quy Nhon climate/transitions dialogue in Vietnam as 4P envoy. Exact day/hour of his remarks unspecified. Later Sciences Po invitation and future MEDays publicity do not alone establish actual attendance.

corrections: Read one-page historical French CV: June 21, 1960 birth in Biltine, 1986 Licence en droit public, 1992 Diplôme d’études supérieures en droit public, and registration for a public-law thesis at Paris 13. It does not confirm a completed doctorate or identify the institutions granting the first two qualifications. Teaching at Marien Ngouabi is not proof it awarded those diplomas. CV supports early legal/administrative work, 1996–1999 sugar company, 1999–2002 presidential civilian cabinet, June 2003–February 2005 prime minister, February 2007–April 2008 economic/social/cultural council, foreign minister from April 2008. Its “to present” end date is historical, not current.

Read historical AU biography: birth and lawyer identity, January 30, 2017 Commission election and March assumption. Its current-office wording is stale; current roles cross-checked elsewhere. Do not adopt its UN Security Council presidency date without independent verification. No language-proficiency rankings or honorary/doctoral degrees inferred.

Read current Mo Ibrahim Foundation profile: prime minister 2003–2005, foreign minister 2008–2017, AU Commission 2017–2025, now 4P Special Envoy. Path includes council but body alone does not prove a formal governing council appointment. Peace-building experience is biographical description, not proof he personally resolved every conflict or achieved all institutional goals.

Read AU March 14, 2017 handover report identifying incoming Faki and outgoing Dlamini-Zuma. March 10–11 retreat is not handover date, and January 30 election is separate. Report supports Agenda 2063, peace/security, trade, women/youth and reforms. Silencing the Guns by 2020 is an objective, not established completion. AU Assembly chair and Commission chair are different offices.

Read official election PDF: election February 6, 2021; release dated February 7. Stale 06/2020 release-number header is not event year. Its 2021–2024 term label is not used to override actual March 2025 handover. Four-year term renewable once corroborated on current AU role page; deputy Monique Nsanzabaganwa is not incoming Commission chair. No unsourced vote tally asserted.

Read AU March 21, 2018 Kigali report: AfCFTA signing, separate Kigali Declaration and movement instrument, Faki remarks and ratification call. Aggregate participation in distinct instruments is not an AfCFTA signature total. Signature, ratification, entry into force and operational trade implementation remain distinct; exact later dates not independently adopted. Treat multilateral agreement as collective member-state action.

Read João Lourenço March 13, 2025 address at actual Commission handover, outgoing Faki and incoming Mahmoud Ali Youssouf. March 14 publication of Faki farewell elsewhere is not a separate later handover date. No precise February election date asserted without further verification.

Read current AU chairperson page: Youssouf incumbent, Faki 2017–2025, four-year renewable-once Commission term, chief executive/legal representative responsibilities and Executive Council reporting. Distinguish Commission governance from rotating AU chair held by member-state heads of state. No extension of Faki office based on old biographies.

Read June 2025 Sevilla Declaration welcoming Faki as new 4P Special Envoy, with international financial architecture/development/climate priorities and OECD-hosted Secretariat. Document gives month; do not invent exact appointment day or equate later public appearance with appointment. 4P is not a UN mission or AU Commission office.

Read current official 4P who-we-are body: platform rooted in June 2023 summit, renamed Pact for Prosperity, People and the Planet, Faki appointed June 2025, political representation remit, Secretariat hosted by OECD. Not its founder in 2025, not OECD Secretary-General, not a UN Special Envoy. Institutional impact claims and membership totals not independently audited or needed for dossier.

Read IRIN February 4, 2005 contemporary resignation report: resigned Thursday February 3, appointed June 2003, public servants striking over salary arrears, no official reason offered. Anonymous claims of presidential disagreement are not established personal motives. Report context is not proof of corruption or a judicial finding. PM and president are different offices.

Read VNA original French report dated October 11, 2026: Quy Nhon climate/transitions dialogue took place Saturday/Sunday October 10–11 in Vietnam, and Faki actually made remarks connecting scientific evidence and political action on climate and finance. He is identified as 4P envoy. No exact hour/day of his own remarks inferred; report date differs from two-day event. Other speakers’ claims and numerical losses are not attributed to him or adopted as independently audited outcomes.
